clean_room_findings_used_by_this_reposit: DoFun theme plugins distinguish the medias widget type from media source modes such as local_music/local_radio/bt_music.
A land theme can publish a generated assets/.gen/c.json capability/index and resolution-specific assets/layout-1280x652 configuration.
The 1280x652 layout family is directly relevant to the physical 1280x720 TS18 when the 55 px top system region is represented outside theme-local coordinates.
The APK remains a minimal no-native RePlugin payload; proprietary code, layouts, images, certificates and APK bytes are not copied into this repository.
evidence_limits: This reference proves a vendor/community theme package contract, not that every field is mandatory on every DoFun version.
The vendor certificate is recorded for comparison only and is not copied or impersonated.
The D8 1.4.77 marker is a compatibility variable, not yet proven to be required by the current host.
